findings.issue: Literal mirror marks the wrong constituent as topic: it renders object 水を as 'as for water', but は actually follows ３リットル. lit_pt mirrors this correctly ('três litros (quanto a isso)'); lit_en contradicts the expl, which says は comes after リットル.
findings.current: In one day, as for water, I drink at least three liters.
findings.suggested: In one day, water, at least three liters (as for that) I drink.
